name: leonin_vanguard_needs_three_creatures
notes: M5 mapper. Printed: 'At the beginning of combat on your turn, if you control three or more creatures, this creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn and you gain 1 life.' Seat 0 controls Leonin Vanguard and one Bear (two creatures; seat 1's two creatures do not count): at the beginning of combat nothing happens, and the Vanguard attacks as a 1/1 beside the Bear. Seat 1 takes 3, seat 0 gains nothing.
